**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

The bump broke two call sites in the link stage.

1. [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) — bundler now passes `retryCount`, not `retries`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. `isBackoffEnabled` threw on that. Now treats `undefined` as `false`.

The rest of the noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc) is just deprecation chatter from the deps themselves, not build-breaking.

Next: nothing.
